turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Okay, looks like most people are here. Let's give it one more minute.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: Morning!

turns.speaker: Grace
turns.text: Morning, everyone.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: Hi all, sorry, I'm Marcus. I joined the design team last week.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Welcome, Marcus. Great to have you with us.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: Welcome! You'll like it here.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Elena, do you want to kick us off with the venue update?

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: Sure. The hotel in Lisbon confirmed our dates, the twelfth to the fourteenth of November.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: That's great news. Did they agree to the group rate?

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: They did, Tom. Two hundred and ten euros a night, breakfast included.

turns.speaker: Grace
turns.text: Do we know how many rooms we actually need?

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Good question. Chris from legal said we can't book more than forty without a new contract.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: Well, forty should be plenty. We're thirty four people right now.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: So, should I start on the badges and the signage?

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Yes please, Marcus. Can you have a first draft by Friday?

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: Friday works.

turns.speaker: Grace
turns.text: I can handle the dietary survey. I'll send it out tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Perfect, thank you.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: One thing. Sarah from finance asked whether we're paying for flights centrally.

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: I think we should. It's cheaper if we book everything in one batch.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Agreed. Tom, can you check with Sarah and confirm?

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: Will do. I'll get back to you by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Marcus
turns.text: Hey Elena, can I get the venue floor plan for the signage?

turns.speaker: Elena
turns.text: Of course. I'll share it right after this call.

turns.speaker: Grace
turns.text: Thanks, Priya. That was quick.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Thanks everyone. Same time next week.
